[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
ㅤ
Adds a vanilla-friendly new game settings button on the character creation menu.
Decide what your new farmer starts out with on a fresh save. Hide settings you don't want.

[list]
[*]Includes support for Multiplayer* and Gamepad.[/*]
[*]Choose your starting backpack size.[/*]
[*]Choose your starting gold from 500 to 2000.[/*]
[*]Start with Trinket Slot** from the beginning.[/*]
[*]Hide certain settings in Advanced Options.[/*]
[*]Configurable and compatibility options for modlist authors.[/*]
[/list]* Only applies to the host farmer. Works fine in split-screen too.
** Not recommended as Mastery doesn't account for this. Option disabled by default.

Should work fine with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26194]QuickSave[/url].
Additional money does not get added to the total stat.
